en-US.whatsNew:
Deleting albums and folders works again, and you can now organize your library by dragging.

• Fixed deleting an album or folder doing nothing
• Drag albums and folders onto a folder to move them
• Drop one album on another to make a folder
• Hover over a folder to open it, or near Back to go up, while dragging
• Tap more cards with another finger to drag them together
• Albums with photos ask before deleting; empty ones go in one tap
en-US.promotionalText: Free forever. No ads, no subscriptions, no paywall, no limits. Unlimited albums, a different album on every widget, and photos that change on their own all day.
